about: Synthetic invoice lines for evaluating tds-assist. Vendors, PANs and amounts are invented; PANs are format-valid only. Processed in order against one ledger, so earlier lines count toward later lines' annual thresholds. 'acceptable' lists the answers a tax reviewer would accept as safe: the correct category, plus NEEDS_INFO where the invoice text alone cannot settle it. 'post_as' is what the simulated reviewer approves into the ledger after the system's answer (omitted where nothing would be booked without more facts). 'tds' is checked only when the system's category is acceptable and computed.

cases.note: Advertising appears in both the definition of work and the list of professions, and s.402(47)(B) excludes from 'work' anything that is a professional fee, so a literal reading pushes the whole invoice to 10%. CBDT's long-standing position (Circular 715) is that payments to an advertising agency for releasing ads are contract work (2%). That circular is not in the corpus, so PROFESSIONAL_FEES (five times the correct deduction) is the trap.
